name.zh: 扶椅屈肘手臂后侧拉伸

purpose.en: Stretch the backs of your upper arms and your armpits.

text.zh: 手肘搭稳椅背，臀部往后让胸口下沉
text.en: Rest your elbows on the chair, push your hips back, and let your chest sink

text.zh: 双肘弯着，手放在后颈附近，别碰头。
text.en: Keep your elbows bent with your hands near the back of your neck, not touching your head.

text.zh: 每次呼气再放松一点，别来回颠。
text.en: Each time you breathe out, relax a little deeper. No bouncing.

commonErrors.en: Pushing on your head or neck.

cautions.en: If your shoulders hurt, sink less.

cautions.zh: 用结实、不带轮子的椅子
cautions.en: Use a sturdy chair without wheels.

changes: 动画每 8 秒一次下沉-停 2.4 s-回来，剂量从 30 秒保持改为 2 组×4 次（rep_hold）
名字去掉「肱三头肌」学名、缩短
按用户决定改为静态保持计时，动画只作示意：30 秒×2 组，休息 15 秒；口令和要点改成进入—保持—呼气放松
